subject: FalconAI surge: throughput errors, proposed credit & contract workplan
messages:
From: Olivia Martinez <olivia@falconai.com>
To: David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Production impact: elevated latency & errors this morning

David —

We hit a pretty significant quality/regression window starting ~08:45 PT. Our user-facing pipeline saw a spike in 5xx errors and p99 latency climbed to ~9.4s for the generate endpoint. This caused delayed responses for customer requests and a partial outage for one internal service.

Key stats (Falcon prod region-us-west):
- 08:45–09:30: 5xx rate 2.8% (baseline 0.03%)
- p50/p95/p99 latency: 120ms / 1.2s / 9.4s
- Approximate impacted requests: ~42k

This is material for us. We need:
1) Immediate confirmation that you see the same signals and an ETA for mitigation.
2) A commercial remediation proposal (credits/refund) while we assess customer impact.
3) A timeboxed plan to prevent recurrence.

We are copying our CFO if this becomes a contractual issue. Please escalate.

Thanks,
Olivia
Director, Platform Reliability
FalconAI

Attachment: none
From: David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Martinez <olivia@falconai.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Production impact: elevated latency & errors this morning

Ben / Marissa —

Forwarding Falcon's report. I just pulled the real-time dashboards; we see the spike originating in the us-west serving cluster tied to a rollout patch (kernel selection path) that increased tail latency under certain long-context requests. Ops is rolling a hotfix now.

Immediate asks:
- Ben: can you take point on the credit proposal and confirm what we can offer under the SLA and what we can do commercially to keep the account stable?
- Marissa: will need an exec sign-off for any above-threshold credit or contract amendment; copying Olivia so the customer sees we are coordinated.

Attaching: falcon_sla_uptime_report.pdf (ops dump), and a first cut credit schedule (proposed_credit_schedule.xlsx).

I'll set a 30-min triage call at 10:00 PT.

Thanks,
David
Account Exec — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: falcon_sla_uptime_report.pdf, proposed_credit_schedule.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Martinez <olivia@falconai.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-17T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production impact: elevated latency & errors this morning

Olivia —

Thanks for flagging and for the data; sorry for the disruption. Quick update: engineering deployed a targeted rollback at 09:58 PT which brought p99 back under 600ms by ~10:10. We will run a secondary verification sweep across heavy-context workloads this afternoon.

Commercially, per the SLA we can offer a service credit calculation:
- SLA metric breached: availability SLO for generate endpoint on region-us-west.
- Proposed credit (one-time): 8% of July invoice for the impacted region, or $26,000, whichever is greater.
- Optional: accelerated one-off credit to cover immediate reconciliation while we finalize the detailed post-incident report.

Operational commitments:
- Hotfix rollback + verification (completed)
- Root cause analysis by 2026-08-19 EOD
- Action plan to guard kernel-selection rollout in canary for long-contexts

If that commercial framing looks acceptable, I can draft the amendment language and route for legal + exec approval. We are available for an exec call today at 4pm PT.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_credit_schedule.xlsx
From: Olivia Martinez <olivia@falconai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephen Lin <stephen.lin@falconai.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production impact: elevated latency & errors this morning

Ben / David —

Appreciate the quick rollback and the proposed numbers. Two points from my side:
1) The $26,000 number is a start but it doesn’t reflect the downstream costs and SL impact to our customers — we will need the credit in-hand for July billing adjustments or a fast reconciliatory path.
2) I’m adding our CFO Stephen Lin; if we can’t get an agreement on a reconciliatory timeline and a contract amendment scoped by EOW, Falcon will consider formal dispute/resolution routes under section 7 of our contract. Not my preference — want to avoid legal escalation.

We are available for the 4pm exec call to align. Please send a calendar invite and the doc you plan to route for exec approval.

Thanks,
Olivia

Quoted text below:
> On 2026-08-17T10:05:00-07:00, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Commercially, per the SLA we can offer a service credit calculation...
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Martinez <olivia@falconai.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production impact: elevated latency & errors this morning

Olivia / team —

Following our exec review, we will proceed with the following immediate commercial and contractual path to resolve Falcon's impact and avoid protracted dispute:

1) Credit schedule (approved): one-time credit equal to 12% of Falcon's July invoice applied to next billing cycle, plus a $10k one-time expedited reconciliation payment to cover immediate customer remediation costs.
2) Contract amendment: Redwood will prepare a short amendment that documents the credit and commits to the technical guardrails we discussed (canary rollout policy, additional rollout gates for kernel selection, and monthly verification for two months). We will route for DocuSign by EOD 2026-08-19.
3) Post-incident deliverables: RCA by 2026-08-19 EOD, plus a 30-day mitigation status update.

Action items:
- David: coordinate the DocuSign package and calendar invite for the 4pm PT exec wrap.
- Ben: attach the amendment and legal redline to the HubSpot deal record (link below).
- Ops: include final ops artifacts in the RCA (falcon_sla_uptime_report.pdf referenced).

I've attached a short call recap. If that schedule works, we will avoid escalation. We will route the amendment with a single executive signature block to expedite.

Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success (EMEA & Strategic)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: call-recap.txt
